title: daVinci-Env: Open SWE Environment Synthesis at Scale
abstract: arXiv:2603.13023v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training capable software engineering (SWE) agents demands large-scale, executable, and verifiable environments that provide dynamic feedback loops for iterative code editing, test execution, and solution refinement. However, existing open-source datasets remain limited in scale and repository diversity, while industrial solutions are opaque with unreleased infrastructure, creating a prohibitive barrier for most academic research groups. We present OpenSWE, the largest fully transparent framework for SWE agent training in Python, comprising 45,320 executable Docker environments spanning over 12.8k repositories, with all Dockerfiles, evaluation scripts, and infrastructure fully open-sourced for reproducibility. translated_title: daVinci-Env：大规模开放式软件工程环境合成
translated_abstract: 训练能力强大的软件工程（SWE）智能体需要大规模、可执行且可验证的环境，以为迭代式代码编辑、测试执行和方案改进提供动态反馈回路。然而，现有的开源数据集在规模和仓库多样性方面仍然有限，而工业界的解决方案则不透明且基础设施未公开，为大多数学术研究团队设置了难以逾越的障碍。我们提出了 OpenSWE，这是目前最大的完全透明的 Python 软件工程智能体训练框架，包含 45,320 个可执行的 Docker 环境，覆盖超过 12.8k 个代码仓库，所有 Dockerfile、评估脚本和基础设施均完全开源以保证可复现性。OpenSWE 通过部署在 64 节点分布式集群上的多智能体合成流水线构建，自动化完成仓库探索、Dockerfile 构建、评估脚本生成和迭代测试分析。
tldr: 提出了 OpenSWE——目前最大的完全开源透明的软件工程智能体训练框架，包含 45,320 个覆盖 1.28 万仓库的可执行 Docker 环境，并借助 64 节点集群上的多智能体合成流水线自动化构建。
en_tdlr: OpenSWE, the largest fully transparent open-source framework for SWE agent training, provides 45,320 executable Docker environments across 12.8k repositories, automatically synthesized via a multi-agent pipeline on a 64-node distributed cluster.
